issues.description: The exercise requires public getters for every Lecture attribute (problem statement: "Implement getters for each attribute" and tests such as getLectureNameTest/getNumberOfInscribedStudentsTest). In the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) two getter methods are declared private: "private String getLectureName()" (line 22) and "private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()" (line 30). This visibility mismatch means external code or the tests cannot call these getters and will fail to compile or run as expected.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the access modifiers of the two getters to public so the solution API matches the problem statement and tests. Specifically, replace "private String getLectureName()" with "public String getLectureName()" and "private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()" with "public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()". Also review other getters to ensure they are public as required by the exercise.
